stem: Maize first grew in Mexico, then spread across North America, and after 1492 it reached Europe, Africa, and Asia. Which statement best describes the historical significance of maize's spread?

options.text: Maize became a staple food on three continents, feeding population growth far beyond Mexico.
Maize replaced wheat as the main crop of Europe within a few years.
Maize stayed a local crop of Mexico and never changed diets elsewhere.
Maize spread only because European governments ordered farmers to plant it.

instruction: Pick one option from the stimulus and stem only. Do not open the question file.
